crossRefs.note: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and…
He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none.…

translations.web: “But the fig tree said to them, ‘Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave back and forth over the trees?’
translations.bsb: But the fig tree replied, ‘Should I stop giving my sweetness and my good fruit, to hold sway over the trees?’
translations.kjv: But the fig tree said unto them, Should I forsake my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to be promoted over the trees?
translations.asv: But the fig-tree said unto them, Should I leave my sweetness, and my good fruit, and go to wave to and fro over the trees?
